```{r}
fig_dir_E2 <- "Figures/Fig4/"

save_fig_E2 <- function(name, width = 7, height = 5, device = grDevices::pdf, bg = "white", dpi = 300) {
  # Ensure directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(fig_dir_E2)) dir.create(fig_dir_E2, recursive = TRUE)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_dir_E2, name),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    dpi = dpi,
    device = device
  )
}

save_chordDiagram_E2 <- function(link_counts, cell_colors,
                                 file_name, width = 10, height = 10, file_type = "pdf") {
  if (!dir.exists(fig_dir_E2)) dir.create(fig_dir_E2, recursive = TRUE)
  file_path <- file.path(fig_dir_E2, file_name)
  circos.clear()

  if (file_type == "pdf") {
    grDevices::pdf(file_path, width = width, height = height)
  } else if (file_type == "png") {
    grDevices::png(file_path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 300)
  } else {
    stop("file_type must be 'pdf' or 'png'")
  }

  circlize::chordDiagram(
    x = link_counts,
    grid.col = cell_colors,
    transparency = 0.3,
    directional = FALSE,
    big.gap = 30
  )
  grDevices::dev.off()
  message("Chord diagram saved to: ", normalizePath(file_path))
}
```

```{r}
# Load clonal info from TREX output
clonedata_E2 <- read.table("Clonal_analysis/TREX_output_E2/clones.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
clonedata_E2$cell_id <- paste0(clonedata_E2$cell_id, "-1")

# Summarize occurrences
clone_summary_E2 <- clonedata_E2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

n_unique_clones_E2 <- clonedata_E2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(clone_nr)) %>%
  summarise(n_unique_clones = n_distinct(clone_nr))

clonedata_E2 %>%
  filter(grepl("^(e16_s1|e16_ji1|e16_c1)", cell_id), !is.na(clone_nr)) %>%
  mutate(prefix = str_extract(cell_id, "^(e16_s1|e16_ji1|e16_c1)")) %>%
  group_by(prefix) %>%
  summarise(n_unique_clones = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(prefix)

sum(clone_summary_E2$count == 1) # 2488 single clones, 3421 clones in total
sum(clone_summary_E2$count > 1) # 933 multicellular clones

# Filter metadata and calculate the average size
avg_clone_stats_E2 <- clonedata_E2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(clone_nr)) %>%
  left_join(clone_summary_E2, by = "clone_nr") %>%
  filter(count > 1) %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise(
    total_clones = n(),
    mean_size = mean(n_cells),
    median_size = median(n_cells),
    max_size = max(n_cells)
  )

print(avg_clone_stats_E2)
```

```{r,fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10, fig.align = "center"}
# Clone categories type
clone_metadata_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(clone_nr)) 

clone_analysis_E2 <- clone_metadata_E2 %>%
  dplyr::select(clone_nr, major_cell_type_2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(major_cell_type_2))

singleton_clones_E2 <- clone_analysis_E2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  filter(n == 1) %>% 
  pull(clone_nr)

length(singleton_clones_E2) # 2488 clones

single_type_clones_E2 <- clone_metadata_E2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(), # number of cells per clone
    n_cell_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_2), # number of cell types per clone
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_cell_types == 1, n_cells > 1) %>% # single-type and more than 1 cell
  pull(clone_nr)

length(single_type_clones_E2) # 394 single-type

multi_type_clones_E2 <- clone_analysis_E2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(n_cell_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_cell_types > 1) %>%
  pull(clone_nr)
length(multi_type_clones_E2) # 539 multi-type clones

E16_barcodes_E2$clone_type <- case_when(
  E16_barcodes_E2$clone_nr %in% single_type_clones_E2 ~ "Single-cell-type multicellular",
  E16_barcodes_E2$clone_nr %in% multi_type_clones_E2 ~ "Multi-cell-type multicellular",
  E16_barcodes_E2$clone_nr %in% singleton_clones_E2 ~ "Singleton",
  is.na(E16_barcodes_E2$clone_nr) ~ "No CloneID",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

E16_barcodes_E2$clone_type <- factor(
  E16_barcodes_E2$clone_type,
  levels = c("Singleton", "Single-cell-type multicellular", "Multi-cell-type multicellular", "No CloneID")
)

DimPlot(E16_barcodes_E2, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "clone_type") + ggtitle(NULL) + xlab("UMAP1") + ylab("UMAP2") 
save_fig_E2("Supp/umap_differenttypesofclones_11celltypes_E2.pdf", height = 6, width = 10)
```

```{r}
# Count total clones per major cell type
total_clones_per_type_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type_2) %>%
  filter(clone_type != "No CloneID") %>%
  summarise(total_clones = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Count singleton clones per major cell type
num_singleton_clones_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% singleton_clones_E2) %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type_2) %>%
  summarise(n_singleton = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Count single-type clones per major cell type
num_single_type_clones_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% single_type_clones_E2) %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type_2) %>%
  summarise(n_single_type = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Count multi-type clones per major cell type
num_multi_type_clones_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% multi_type_clones_E2) %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type_2) %>%
  summarise(n_multi_type = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Combine all counts
clone_counts_E2 <- total_clones_per_type_E2 %>%
  left_join(num_singleton_clones_E2, by = "major_cell_type_2") %>%
  left_join(num_single_type_clones_E2, by = "major_cell_type_2") %>%
  left_join(num_multi_type_clones_E2, by = "major_cell_type_2") %>%
  mutate(
    n_singleton = replace_na(n_singleton, 0),
    n_single_type = replace_na(n_single_type, 0),
    n_multi_type = replace_na(n_multi_type, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_singleton = n_singleton / total_clones * 100,
    pct_single_type = n_single_type / total_clones * 100,
    pct_multi_type = n_multi_type / total_clones * 100
  )

clone_counts_E2
```

```{r}
# Prepare for the Upset Plot For E2
clone_metadata_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(clone_nr)) # remove NA

clone_counts_E2 <- as.data.frame(table(clone_metadata_E2$clone_nr))
colnames(clone_counts_E2) <- c("clone_nr", "cell_count")
shared_clones_E2 <- clone_counts_E2 %>%
  filter(cell_count > 1) # only leaving multicellular clones

shared_clone_metadata_E2 <- clone_metadata_E2 %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% shared_clones_E2$clone_nr)

clone_analysis_E2 <- shared_clone_metadata_E2 %>%
  dplyr::select(clone_nr, major_cell_type_2)

data_wide_E2 <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(clone_analysis_E2$clone_nr, clone_analysis_E2$major_cell_type_2))
celltype_E2 <- colnames(data_wide_E2)
set_sizes_E2 <- colSums(data_wide_E2)

# Compute total number of cells per clone (sum across all cell types)
clone_sizes_E2 <- rowSums(data_wide_E2)

# Convert to binary for UpSet intersections
binary_matrix_E2 <- data_wide_E2 %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(. > 0, 1, 0))) 
binary_matrix_E2$Clone_Size <- clone_sizes_E2
sets_vec_E2 <- colnames(binary_matrix_E2)[-ncol(binary_matrix_E2)]
```

```{r,fig.height = 8, fig.width = 15, fig.align = "center"}
pdf(file.path(fig_dir_E2, "Uplot_11celltypes_minimal2.pdf"), width = 17, height = 8, onefile = FALSE)
grid::grid.newpage()
upset(
  binary_matrix_E2[, -ncol(binary_matrix_E2)],
  sets = sets_vec_E2,
  nintersects = 60, # minimum 2
  order.by = "freq",
  sets.x.label = "Total multicellular clones",
  text.scale = c(2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2),
  point.size = 5
) #Fig 4F
dev.off()
```

```{r}
clone_links_major_E2_2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  filter(clones_per_cell_4 == "Multicellular") %>%
  dplyr::select(clone_nr, major_cell_type_2) %>%  
  distinct()

clone_pairs_E2_major_2 <- clone_links_major_E2_2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    types = list(unique(major_cell_type_2)),
    n_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_types >= 2) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pairs = list(combn(types, 2, simplify = FALSE))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(pairs) %>%
  mutate(
    from = sapply(pairs, `[`, 1),  
    to   = sapply(pairs, `[`, 2),  
    value = 1                       
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(from, to) %>%           
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop")

self_links_E2_major_2 <- clone_links_major_E2_2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    types = list(unique(major_cell_type_2)), 
    n_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_2),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_types == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = sapply(types, `[`, 1),  
    value = 1 
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%               
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(from = cell_type, to = cell_type) %>%
  select(from, to, value)

pairwise_links_all_E2_major_2 <- bind_rows(clone_pairs_E2_major_2, self_links_E2_major_2) 
pairwise_links_all_E2_major_2 <- pairwise_links_all_E2_major_2 %>% dplyr::select(from, to, value)

grid_colors_full <- setNames(distinct11, E16_barcodes_levels_major2)
cell_types_E2 <- intersect(
  E16_barcodes_levels_major2,
  unique(c(pairwise_links_all_E2_major_2$from,

)
```

```{r,fig.height = 8, fig.width = 10, fig.align = "center"}
# Produce gene-wise Z-scores for pseudobulks, cell type transcriptomic similarity for correlation matrix for E2
# Set cell identities
Idents(E16_barcodes_E2) <- "assigned_cell_type"

# Compute pseudobulk (average expression per cell type)
genes.use_E2.1 <- VariableFeatures(E16_barcodes_E2) # 3000 genes
expr_E2 <- GetAssayData(E16_barcodes_E2, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[genes.use_E2.1, ] # rows genes-log normalised SCTransformed corrected UMIs columns cells

df_corr_E2 <- data.frame(
  cell = colnames(E16_barcodes_E2),
  class = E16_barcodes_E2$assigned_cell_type,
  t(expr_E2), # Transpose, from 3rd column onwards
  check.names = FALSE
)

mean_expr_corr_E2 <- df_corr_E2 %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(genes.use_E2.1), mean), .groups = "drop")

mat_corr_E2 <- as.matrix(mean_expr_corr_E2[, -1]) 

rownames(mat_corr_E2) <- mean_expr_corr_E2$class
mat.z_E2 <- scale(mat_corr_E2)

cor.mat_E2 <- cor(t(mat.z_E2), method = "pearson")
## Hierarchical clustering
dist.mat_E2 <- as.dist(1 - cor.mat_E2)
hc_E2 <- hclust(dist.mat_E2, method = "average")

pdf(file.path(fig_dir_E2, "gene-wise Z-scores_27celltypes.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8)
Heatmap(
  cor.mat_E2,
  name = "Transcriptome correction",
  cluster_rows = hc_E2,
  cluster_columns = hc_E2,
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#3B4CC0", "white", "#B40426")),
  border = TRUE
) # Supplementary
dev.off()
```

```{r}
cols_links <- c(
  "Mesodermal" = "#FFD700",  
  "Neural Crest" = "#6a0dad",  
  "Endodermal" = "#FF69B4"   
)

clone_links_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
  filter(clones_per_cell_4 == "Multicellular") %>%
  dplyr::select(clone_nr, major_cell_type_3) %>%  
  distinct()

clone_pairs_E2_2 <- clone_links_E2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    types = list(unique(major_cell_type_3)),
    n_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_types >= 2) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pairs = list(combn(types, 2, simplify = FALSE))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(pairs) %>%
  mutate(
    from = sapply(pairs, `[`, 1),  
    to   = sapply(pairs, `[`, 2),  
    value = 1                       
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(from, to) %>%           
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop")

self_links_E2_2 <- clone_links_E2 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    types = list(unique(major_cell_type_3)), 
    n_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_3),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_types == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = sapply(types, `[`, 1),  
    value = 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%                
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(from = cell_type, to = cell_type) %>%
  select(from, to, value)

pairwise_links_all_E2_2 <- bind_rows(clone_pairs_E2_2, self_links_E2_2) 
pairwise_links_all_E2_2 <- pairwise_links_all_E2_2 %>% dplyr::select(from, to, value)

sectors <- unique(c(pairwise_links_all_E2_2$from, pairwise_links_all_E2_2$to))
grid.col <- cols_links[sectors]

pdf(file.path(fig_dir_E2, "chorddigram_clonebased_E2.pdf"), width = 3, height = 3)
circos.clear()
chordDiagram(
  pairwise_links_all_E2_2,
  grid.col = grid.col,
  transparency = 0.4 
)  # Fig 4G
dev.off()
```
